title: BBR-* items
summary: Bottom bracket item family covering BBR-* components, stock levels, and warehouse allocations at Northbridge Cycles.
body:
The `BBR-*` item family covers bottom bracket components used in Northbridge Cycles assembly and maintenance operations. As of 26 October 2026 at 09:00 GMT, inventory tracking records current balances and allocations across warehouse locations via [[data-stock-on-hand|Stock_on_hand_2026-10-26_0900]][^r1]. Management of stock balances and movements is handled through the [[services-pur-stk|PUR stk services]][^r1].

## Stock levels

At 09:00 on 26 October 2026, bottom bracket item BBR-01 at warehouse location WH-MAN-STR had 14 units on hand, 1 unit allocated, and 0 units on order[^r1].

| Item code | Description | Warehouse | On hand | Allocated | On order |
